name: Mindi Abair's Wine & Jazz
description: Indulge in a luxurious evening combining world-class jazz performances with exquisite wine tasting at one of Gaia's most prestigious hotels.
longDescription:
Mindi Abair's Wine & Jazz is a series of evening events hosted at The Yeatman Hotel, bringing together live jazz performances with curated wine selections. The event features Mindi Abair, a Grammy-nominated saxophonist known for her contemporary jazz style and collaborations across various genres. This event series offers guests an opportunity to engage with her music in an intimate setting, complemented by the hotel's expertise in viticulture.

Guests attending Mindi Abair's Wine & Jazz can expect an evening of live music and wine tasting within the grand setting of The Yeatman Hotel, located in Vila Nova de Gaia. The atmosphere is designed for adults interested in both jazz music and fine wines. The event runs over several evenings, allowing for a focused experience each night. The hotel's elevated position offers views over Porto and the Douro River.

Booking is required for attendance at Mindi Abair's Wine & Jazz. The Yeatman Hotel is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, accessible by taxi or a walk from the General Torres metro station (approximately 15-20 minutes uphill). Limited parking is available on-site.
